sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:63286
Court No. - 12
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 9740 of 2024

Applicant :- Vimal Kishor
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru.
Civil Secretariat Home Deptt. Lko
Counsel for Applicant :- Shiv Poojan Verma

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.

2. The accused-applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No.233 of 2024 under sections 323, 376, 406,
504, 506 IPC, P.S. Kotwali Nagar, District Gonda.
3. In terms of the FIR it was alleged that the victim met the applicant sometimes in the year 2017 and physical relations were formed allegedly on the false pretext of marriage.
It was also stated that certain moneys were transferred in the account of the applicant.
Vimal Kishor vs State Of U.P. Thru.Civil Secretariat ... on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/74508007/

entities.text: Vimal Kishor vs State Of U.P. Thru.Civil Secretariat
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
1 4. In short, the submission of the counsel for the applicant is that on the false pretext of marriage,
the relationship continued since the year 2017.
The tentative age of the victim is around 34 years.

5. Considering the fact that even as per the version in the FIR, the physical relations continued over a span of seven years allegedly on the false pretext of marriage and considering the law as explained in the case of Deepak Gulati vs State of Haryana; 2013 (7) SCC 675, the applicant is entitled for the bail.

entities.text: Deepak Gulati vs State of Haryana; 2013 (7) SCC 675
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Thus the bail application is allowed.

5. Let the applicant Vimal Kishor be released on bail in aforesaid first information report number subject to his furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- (Twenty Thousand) each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 12.9.2024 VNP/-
 
Vimal Kishor vs State Of U.P. Thru.
